project_name.justification: The article is titled "Stratabound Acquires 100% Ownership of Golden Culvert Property..." and refers to the "Golden Culvert and the adjacent Little Hyland (collectively "Golden Culvert") gold properties".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Stratabound Minerals Corp. (TSXV: SB) (OTCQB: SBMIF) ("Stratabound" or the "Company")".

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the CEO in multiple places: "President and CEO Mr. R. Kim Tyler remarked..." and "Mr. R. Kim Tyler, P.Geo., President and CEO of Stratabound...".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Stratabound "has now acquired an undivided 100% mineral rights interest in the Golden Culvert and the adjacent Little Hyland (collectively "Golden Culvert") gold properties".

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the asset as the "Golden Culvert... gold properties, Tombstone Gold Belt, Yukon Territory."

verified_article_link.justification: The article content is entirely about the Golden Culvert project and the company Stratabound Minerals Corp. acquiring it.

currency.justification: The article announces the completion of a pre-existing option agreement and does not specify any new financial consideration, so no currency is mentioned.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The article announces the completion of an option agreement but does not specify any cash consideration was paid to finalize it.

share_payments_raw.justification: The article announces the completion of an option agreement but does not specify any share consideration was paid to finalize it.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The article does not provide any financial details for the completion of the option agreement.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The article does not mention any shares being issued as part of the transaction completion.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned in the article.

option_payments_raw.justification: The article states that Stratabound "has completed all option agreement commitments" but does not detail what those final payments, if any, were.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were mentioned as being issued, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The article describes "Future planned work" but does not state a specific drilling commitment in meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The article describes "Future planned work" but does not state a specific exploration spending commitment in monetary terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The article does not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) being acquired or retained as part of the transaction.

coverage_area_unit.justification: No coverage area value was found, so no unit can be extracted.

resource_size.justification: The article mentions a resource estimate for a different project: "The Fremont Property features an NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) of 1.16 million Au ounces...". No resource estimate is provided for the Golden Culvert project.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as Stratabound Minerals Corp., and the text explicitly states its ticker is "(TSXV: SB)".
